required_assets: complete model weights loadable by AutoModelForCausalLM
provider_loading.ci_offline_behavior: Most adaptors set local_files_only only when CI == 'true'. qwen25_72b, qwen25_coder_32b, and qwen3_32b also treat HF_HUB_OFFLINE or TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE as local-only. Hugging Face may independently honor its own offline environment variables.
provider_loading.checkpoint_distribution: No checkpoint, tokenizer, firmware, or driver is supplied by the intended standalone wheel. Access and local population are external prerequisites.

tensor_cache_policy.writability: Adaptors create cache directories. The cache root must therefore be writable.
tensor_cache_policy.llama3_8b_special_case: The adaptor derives model_cache/<HF_MODEL>/<device_name> when TT_CACHE_PATH is absent and falls back to TT_CACHE_FALLBACK_PATH or /tmp/tttv2_model_cache on a permission failure.
tensor_cache_policy.dp_lane_behavior: Several demos derive a topology-specific sibling cache directory for each tensor-parallel lane, so the caller's cache root and whether the adaptor appends a topology are model-specific.
tensor_cache_policy.qualification_runner: The vLLM hardware gate requires an externally supplied expectations file that pins HF_HOME, snapshot, refs, revisions, verified files, and per-row TT cache roots; it rejects revision/ref mismatch and cache fallback.

committed_test_assets.reference_presence: A matching .refpt exists for every one of the twelve demo defaults at the pinned source revision.
committed_test_assets.reference_provenance_gap: Eleven committed references contain only top5_tokens and reference_tokens, without model revision metadata. Qwen2-7B alone records hf_model_id and revision f2826a00ceef68f0f2b946d945ecc0477ce4450c plus generation metadata.
